title: Fake Linear Time
subtitle: Test your grasp of Fake Linear Time — elastic true time, 96-hour days, clock anchors, Twin Flame bending, Amnesia Vortex loops, lifespan theft, and EMF collapse of the temporal prison.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Linear time is not natural law — it is an elongated 3rd-density overlay that stretched the second, cut the day from ~96 hours to 24, blackened true dusk with void plasma, and chained minds to clocks, watches, and phone schedules for Loosh. Twin Flames still show how time really moves; the Amnesia Vortex keeps the loop sealed every 15–20 minutes after death. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Fake Linear Time deep-dive. When the G.A.A. EMF flash strips the overlays, 178,000 years return at once — and schedule-bound NPCs and the unawakened meet total cognitive failure.
